title: GenerateContentBatchOutput
description: The output of a batch request. This is returned in the `BatchGenerateContentResponse` or the `GenerateContentBatch.output` field.

responsesFile.description: Output only. The file ID of the file containing the responses. The file will be a JSONL file with a single response per line. The responses will be `GenerateContentResponse` messages formatted as JSON. The responses will be written in the same order as the input requests.
